guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: 2026 Guidance: Following another strong quarter, PayPal is raising full year non-GAAP TM$ and EPS guidance and reaffirming GAAP EPS guidance. Please see PayPal’s 3Q'26 earnings presentation for more detail.

October 2026 Guidance | July 2026 Guidance | Prior year period
GAAP EPS | ~$1.37 | N/A | $1.53
Non-GAAP EPS1 | ~$1.43 | N/A | $1.23
GAAP EPS2 | ~$5.07 | Mid-single digit decline | $5.41
Non-GAAP EPS3 | ~$5.60 | ~$5.38 | $5.31

Please see “Non-GAAP Measures of Financial Performance” for reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures and important additional information.

1. Estimated non-GAAP amounts for the three months ending December 31, 2026 reflect adjustments of approximately $70 million. 2. FY'25 GAAP EPS included a positive impact of ~$0.14 from PayPal’s strategic investment portfolio and crypto assets held for investment. 3. Estimated non-GAAP amounts for the full year ending December 31, 2026 reflect adjustments of approximately $570 million. | 3Q 2026 Results | 2
